description: The dozing cat wakes, holds the awake lying pose for a drawn few seconds, and settles again. The nap cycle's own 20 s timer still runs underneath (art direction 2026-08-19); this is the shared-clock stir on top of it, so every viewer sees the same wake at the same second. Named 'cat', not 'Gherkin' — Gate A §8.3 defers the codename, so the id stays generic and a later name is a content edit.
